The story so far: Prime Minister Narendra Modi recently used his address to a hall full of India’s top corporate leaders to castigate them on a variety of issues affecting the Indian economy. Several of these concerns have been raised by the Opposition in the past as well, but the Prime Minister’s acknowledgement lends greater weight to these issues.
One of the sharpest criticisms Mr. Modi leveled at the assembled industry captains during FICCI’s Annual General Meeting on Thursday (November 19, 2026) was that the Indian industry had barely made any progress towards enhancing India’s domestic manufacturing since the 1930s.
